name: Date Picker
summary: Single-date entry and selection contract with an editable ISO text owner, explicit calendar trigger, non-modal dialog, roving-focus grid, native form lifecycle, bounds, and validation-preserving field states.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Relative wrapper for the input trigger and calendar panel.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Editable native text input that owns the ISO date value, validation, form submission, and popup relationship.

anatomy.name: trigger
anatomy.description: Explicit button that opens or closes the calendar without replacing the input as value owner.

anatomy.name: calendar
anatomy.description: Anchored non-modal dialog containing month navigation and the date grid.

anatomy.name: monthYear
anatomy.description: Visible current month and year label.

anatomy.name: nav
anatomy.description: Optional wrapper for month navigation controls.

anatomy.name: weekday
anatomy.description: Column header with an abbreviated visible label and full accessible weekday name.

anatomy.name: week
anatomy.description: Semantic grid row containing seven day cells.

anatomy.name: day
anatomy.description: Native button exposed as one date gridcell; only the roving focus target participates in sequential navigation.

states.name: closed
states.description: Calendar panel is visually hidden while the field remains available.

states.name: open
states.description: Calendar panel is visible below the input.

states.name: inputHover
states.description: Pointer hover state that preserves the active validation family.

states.name: inputFocus
states.description: Four-pixel zero-offset focus hierarchy on the input.

states.name: inputReadOnly
states.description: Readable and submittable value whose editing and calendar trigger are unavailable.

states.name: triggerHover
states.description: Pointer affordance on the explicit calendar trigger.

states.name: triggerFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the explicit calendar trigger.

states.name: triggerDisabled
states.description: Trigger state synchronized from disabled or read-only input ownership.

states.name: navHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on month navigation controls.

states.name: dayHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on a day cell.

states.name: dayFocus
states.description: Visible focus for the single roving day target.

states.name: outside
states.description: Visible day from the previous or next month.

behavior.name: inputRelationship
behavior.description: The editable input owns the popup relationship and expanded state; the explicit button references the same calendar dialog.

behavior.name: dialogRelationship
behavior.description: The anchored calendar is a named non-modal dialog and announces month changes without asserting modal behavior.

behavior.name: calendarGrid
behavior.description: Six explicit week rows expose date buttons as gridcells, with one enabled day at tabindex zero and all other days at minus one.

behavior.name: monthNavigation
behavior.description: Visible controls move by month; Page keys preserve the day when possible and Shift plus Page keys move by year.

behavior.name: dayKeyboardNavigation
behavior.description: Arrow navigation respects writing direction, Home and End move within the week, Enter or Space selects, and Escape returns focus to the input.

behavior.name: selectionState
behavior.description: Visual day states must stay synchronized with selected, current, outside-month, and disabled data.

behavior.name: valueAndBounds
behavior.description: Selection serializes a local calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, honors inclusive ISO min and max bounds, and emits native input then change events.

behavior.name: formLifecycle
behavior.description: The native text input owns submission and constraint attributes; reset restores its authored value and closes the popup.

behavior.name: controlledAndUncontrolled
behavior.description: Uncontrolled targets enhance the authored input value; controlled adapters write value and open state back after observing native events.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible accessible name associated with the native editable input.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation for the selected date value.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Editable and selected local calendar date serialized as YYYY-MM-DD.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Format hint displayed while the editable value is empty.

properties.name: autocomplete
properties.description: Native autofill hint for the text input.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Inclusive lower bound serialized as YYYY-MM-DD.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Inclusive upper bound serialized as YYYY-MM-DD.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls calendar visibility and the input expanded state.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Prevents editing and calendar selection while preserving focus, selection, and form submission.

properties.name: required
properties.description: Marks the date input as required and shows the standardized decorative marker on its composing Field Wrapper label.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id reference for date guidance or validation feedback.

accessibility: Keep the editable ISO input value synchronized with the selected calendar day without converting it through UTC.
Keep the explicit calendar trigger keyboard reachable and named for choosing or changing the current date.
Expose the anchored calendar as a named non-modal dialog with explicit week rows and one roving gridcell tab stop.
Expose the current day with aria-current="date" when it is visible.
Expose selected and disabled days to assistive technology.
Support direction-aware arrow navigation, week boundaries, month and year movement, selection, and Escape focus return.
Preserve the Input contract's visible label and description requirements.

web.notes: Implemented by components/css/forms.css and the progressive enhancer in components/js/theme.js, including local ISO parsing, popup state, bounds, roving grid focus, native events, and form reset.
